title: Lunisolar

inlines.v: LUNISO'LAR, adjective [Latin luna, moon, and solaris, sol, sun.] Compounded of the revolutions of the sun and moon. The lunisolar year consists of 532 common years; found by multiplying the cycle of the sun by that of the moon.
